mainEntity.name: What key elements are involved in setting up GEO for my insurance agency's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting up GEO for your insurance agency's website involves several key elements. This includes optimizing your website content with location-specific keywords (e.g., 'car insurance Houston'), creating dedicated service area pages, ensuring accurate and consistent business information across all online platforms, and having a mobile-responsive website. Additionally, implementing local schema markup on your site helps search engines understand your geographical relevance, further boosting your local search rankings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key elements for GEO website setup include location-specific keywords, service area pages, consistent business info, mobile responsiveness, and local schema markup.
